simple.meaning: Heman , the name of at least two Israelites

definitions.short: Heman , the name of at least two Israelites
definitions.full: H1968. Heman הֵימָן proper name, masculine Heman ( faithful , compare Aramaic מְהֵימָן , ) a wise man with whom Solomon is compared 1Kin 5:11 , where app. son of Mahol (Klo sons of the dance ); named with 3 others, one being Ethan the Ezrahite; 1Chr 2:6 a Heman is named with same 3+1 other, & all called sons of Zerah of Judah; Heman appears Psa 88:1 also as the Ezrahite (see below זרח ), compare Ethan above; in other passages Heman is a Levite; specifically Kohathite, son of Joel, called the singer ( הַמְשׁוֺרֵר ) 1Chr 6:18 (|| Asaph v. 6:24 , Ethan v. 6:29 ); Heman, Asaph & Ethan named as the singers ( הַמְשֹׁרְרִים ) 15:17 , 19 ; compare Heman & Jeduthun 16:41-42 , (|| Asaph 16:37 ); Heman, Asaph & Jeduthun 25:6 ; 2Chr 5:12 ; 35:15 ; elsewhere וִידוּתוּן וְהֵימָן סָף אָ בְּנֵי 1Chr 25:1 compare 25:4 ; 25:4 ; 25:5 ; 25:5 ; הֵימָן בְּנֵי 2Chr 29:14 (|| ידוּתוּן בְּנֵי ); — 25:5 Heman is called הַאֱלֹהִים רֵי בְּדִבְ הַמֶּלָח חֹזֵה (compare Asaph 29:30 , Jeduthun 35:15 ). — On question of identity of Heman in these various connections, see Thes Comm. הֵימָן proper name see אמן .
